items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson listed as full participant in Wednesday practice for the first time since ankle injury.
items.why: First full practice since injury; missed prior three games.
items.implication: Expected to play vs Bills; unlocks Ravens offense and Flowers.
items.opportunity: Full snaps likely; Flowers YPRR boost.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) listed as non-participant at Wednesday practice.
items.why: Shoulder injury; awkward hit late in prior game noted.
items.implication: Monitor Thu/Fri; no indication of miss yet but new issue.

items.text: Eagles placed RB Dameon Pierce on IR and signed RB Jaydon Blue to active roster.
items.implication: Clears path but Barkley also DNP hamstring/back.

items.text: Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) non-participant Wednesday; Campbell expects Thursday return.
items.why: Ankle from Packers win; planned rest then ramp.
items.implication: Likely plays vs Vikings but monitor.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into lineup?
items.why: Return from IR; prior benching context.
items.implication: Lineup decision; monitor snaps vs Charbonnet/Wilson.
items.opportunity: Potential committee or lead if volume.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest.
Time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield (Silva/Levitan).
items.why: Return efficiency, Payton comments, snap lead over Harvey/Dobbins.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle aggravated prior chest injury on reverse; status TBD based on practice, DNP Wednesday.
Zay Flowers leads NFL YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Doyle/Lamar.
items.why: Elite efficiency under backup; Lamar return multiplies.
items.implication: Flowers smash spot with healthy Lamar.

items.text: Sell Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson? Prefer sell Olave over unproven rookie.
items.why: Prefer proven production to rookie upside.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; big day possible vs Vikings defense pressuring Goff.
items.implication: Start with confidence in TE slot.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba truly special: loses Kubiak, coverage shaded, known target, still 9 actual FP above opportunity.
items.why: Massive overperformance vs opportunity despite scheme/talent loss.
items.implication: Elite WR1 lock ROS; buy if available.

items.text: Ollie Gordon scored 14+ PPR in last 4; entering MUST-START territory.
Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2, Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4, LaPorta TE6, Jamo WR24.
items.why: Defensive woes, schedule, talent concentration drive production.
items.implication: Start Lions skill with confidence; Gibbs RB1.
